text.aria-label: Subtitle text '3 wind farms (W1 to W3), Tuesday runs from October 2025 to June 2026, rows kept by the idle-row mask, offset table applied to every arm. Dot: estimate. Line: 98.33% interval for decisive contrasts, 95% for the rest, from resampling whole months and seeds. Dashed line: no difference.'
text.tspan: 3 wind farms (W1 to W3), Tuesday runs from October 2025 to June 2026, rows kept
by the idle-row mask, offset table applied to every arm.
Dot: estimate. Line: 98.33% interval for decisive contrasts, 95% for the rest,
from resampling whole months and seeds. Dashed line: no difference.
